raw_response:
I will plant cotton on the full 2 mu, same as last year. I do not like to change too much at my age. If something works in the village, I follow that. Around here, people with well water do better when they put a solid base fertilizer in first, then add more when the cotton starts growing hard and setting bolls. My land is only 2 mu, so every bag costs money, but a poor harvest costs more than a little extra fertilizer. I will use improved seed because I have seen newer seed do better than old saved seed, especially when the stand comes up more even. I will plough first, then make the field fine enough for sowing. For fertilizer, I will not go light. I will put enough for a steady start and then chase it once or twice. With well irrigation, I will water about 4 times if the season is normal: once after emergence if dry, once at squaring, once at flowering, and once when bolls are filling. Cotton always brings insects and some disease, so I will plan on 5 sprays in the year, more or less following what I see in my own field and what nearby farmers are doing. If the weather behaves, I will aim for about 320 kilos per mu.
